fetched_title: Do LLMs Know a Good Hypothesis When They See One? Logit-Based Energy Scoring Outperforms Prompted LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Hypothesis Ranking
summary: Scores 1,323 papers across 12 disciplines, each paired with its gold hypothesis and fifteen incorrect alternatives, comparing logit-based energy scoring of seven LLMs with prompted listwise LLM-as-judge ranking (33.0% vs 16.6% Hit@1 pooled). Every pool contains the correct hypothesis, so it is target-present only; only v1 exists.
